title: This Free Gym App Knows You Skip Legs
description:
This free gym app shows the muscles you've been skipping. openGym is a self-hosted workout tracker: 5,600+ exercises with demos, plate math, a muscle map. No subscription, no ads. Nearly 7,000 GitHub stars this week.

Full breakdown: https://youtu.be/-uAf9tqI8aU
Source: https://github.com/DuarteSantos8/openGym
Images: Wikimedia Commons (credits in the full video's description); app screenshots from the openGym repository (AGPL-3.0). AI voice (Chatterbox), AI music. Animated in code. Not affiliated with openGym.
